content.text: If you're trying to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-nobody-tells|digital]] products in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or other countries where Stripe is unavailable, you're likely facing a daunting infrastructure problem: how to collect payments without relying on a US-based payment processor. This is the exact situation many creators in Zimbabwe, Pakistan, and Bangladesh find themselves in. They've been forced to look for alternative solutions that can handle the unique challenges of restricted countries, but they're often left confused by the options available. In this post, we'll cut through the noise and provide a clear comparison of setting up [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-complete|How to]] webhooks with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-4|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Workers.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Nowpayments webhook

When it comes to setting up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, you have two primary options: using the NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers or leveraging the NOWPayments Sandbox environment. The integration with Cloudflare Workers allows you to send incoming payments directly to Cloudflare Workers, which can then process and store the payment data. This setup is ideal for creators who need to automate complex business logic and want to avoid manual data entry. On the other hand, the NOWPayments Sandbox environment provides a simulated testing environment where you can try out different scenarios without affecting your live payment data. This is particularly useful for developers who want to test their payment flows before deploying them to production.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, both options have their strengths and weaknesses. The NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers can be configured to handle restricted countries by using IP blocking or geolocation-based rules. This allows you to block payments from specific countries or regions while still allowing payments from other areas. However, this approach can be complex to set up and requires ongoing maintenance to ensure it remains effective. In contrast, the NOWPayments Sandbox environment is particularly well-suited for testing payment flows in restricted countries. By simulating payments from different countries, you can test your payment logic and ensure it works as expected before deploying it to production.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, both options have their advantages. The NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers can handle fast and low-cost transactions, particularly when using popular cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron, which costs under $0.10 per transaction in network fees. However, the integration also incurs a 0.5% fee on all transactions. In contrast, the NOWPayments Sandbox environment does not incur any fees, making it an attractive option for developers who want to test payment flows without incurring additional costs. However, the sandbox environment is not suitable for production use and should not be used for handling live payments.
The NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers provides the best balance of automation, ownership, and cost-effectiveness for advanced creators.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, both options have their strengths and weaknesses. The NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers allows creators to maintain full ownership of their payment data and automate complex business logic, making it ideal for advanced creators who want to automate their entire payment workflow. However, this integration requires significant development effort to set up and maintain. In contrast, the NOWPayments Sandbox environment provides a simple and easy-to-use interface for testing payment flows, but it does not offer the same level of automation and ownership as the NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice between setting up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers using the NOWPayments integration or the NOWPayments Sandbox environment depends on your specific situation. If you're a advanced creator who wants to automate complex business logic and maintain full ownership of your payment data, the NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers is the better choice. However, if you're a developer who wants to test payment flows without incurring additional costs, the NOWPayments Sandbox environment is a better option.
How to integrate NOWPayments?

The most important question you should ask is: which option provides the best balance of automation, ownership, and cost-effectiveness for my specific situation? The answer depends on your level of technical expertise, your payment needs, and your willingness to incur additional costs. If you're unsure, consider starting with the NOWPayments Sandbox environment to test your payment flows before deploying them to production.
Using the NOWPayments Sandbox environment is a great way to test payment flows without incurring additional costs.

Your Deployment Checklist

To set up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, follow these steps: create a NOWPayments account and set up a Cloudflare Workers account; configure the NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers according to your payment needs; test your payment flows using the NOWPayments Sandbox environment; deploy your payment infrastructure to production; and configure your Cloudflare Workers to send incoming payments directly to the NOWPayments API for processing and storage.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers?

The NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers is a pre-configured integration that allows you to send incoming payments directly to Cloudflare Workers for processing and storage. This integration is ideal for advanced creators who want to automate complex business logic and maintain full ownership of their payment data.
What is the NOWPayments Sandbox environment?

The NOWPayments Sandbox environment is a simulated testing environment where you can try out different payment scenarios without affecting your live payment data. This environment is ideal for developers who want to test payment flows before deploying them to production.
How do I configure the NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers?

To configure the NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers, you need to set up a NOWPayments account and a Cloudflare Workers account, and then configure the integration according to your payment needs. This may involve setting up IP blocking or geolocation-based rules to handle restricted countries.
What are the fees associated with using the NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers?
The NOWPayments integration with Cloudflare Workers incurs a 0.5% fee on all transactions. This fee is in addition to any network fees associated with the transaction.
Can I use the NOWPayments Sandbox environment for production payments?
No, the NOWPayments Sandbox environment is not suitable for production payments. It is intended for testing payment flows only.
